plan_owner_impacts.impact: All new surfaces: BSD selector chip + popup, provider icon rail, selectable account rows, sync strip, title-bar inbox, grant/capacity/ops/attachment/resolution cards, receipts row, offline composer states.
Theme-token-only treatments for BSD states (.pmq-bsd-off/auto/active/on), port/worktree state chips, capacity forecast chip; no browser-only filters.
Provider rail + setup states (install-required / update-available) and disabled-model reason rows in the picker; Chat deep-links to Settings, never manages providers itself.
Account identity in picker (selectable account rows, connection kind labels, Account · label · connection footer line) and same-model-two-account distinct routes.
Context Lens receipt (Included/Left out with provenance, sizes, removable excerpts) is a projection; admission data stays pipeline-owned.
Below-threshold memories appear only as a Left-out reason in the admission receipt.
Persona capsule listed as an Included admission source; no persona logic re-owned.

cmd.chat.goal.* are projections of canonical Goal Runtime events (GRS lineage); Chat never owns scheduler truth. start/pause/resume/stop/update/replan wired; clear stays a local presentation mutation.
Subagent records gain explicit route + queued/blocked/stopped/completed statuses; capacity forecast card (Requested 6 / Recommended 2 / 3 waves) defers execution authority to Orchestrator.
No direct impact; capacity forecast wording only.
No direct impact.
Cross-project grant card with read/write distinction and one-time scopes (Allow once / Allow for this Goal / Open Settings / Cancel); choice never persists silently.
Receipt note keeps FileSafe rulebook hidden; attachment alternate-route consent respects FileSafe boundaries.
Selected tools listed in admission Included; 17 unused tool schemas listed in Left out.
Unsupported video attachment flow (Cancel / Extract in PM / Use Gemini) with consent-before-route ordering.
BSD attribution states, cache-loss route warning, attachment transform metering placeholders; Usage page stays owned by the parallel Usage redesign.
Worktree state chips (isolated / waiting-writer / conflict / patch-preserved / cleanup-pending) and port-collision cards are projections; worktree truth stays owned by Worktrees.
Browser Program terminology sweep (browser capture -> Browser Program capture); artifact workspace commands renamed to cmd.chat.artifact.*.
Offline/outbox/reconnect/replay/snapshot states: durable client IDs as idempotency keys, replay exactly once, snapshot catch-up never rewrites canonical messages.
Title-bar inbox boundary replaces transient toasts for important events; bell + unread count, mark-read, Open thread deep links. No bottom-right stack, no Activity Bar icon.
Provider setup states deep-link to Settings (settings:provider); Chat never becomes Provider Manager.
